d:
Every dog deserves a chance at a better life, and at Villalobos Rescue Center, even the most difficult cases can lead to heartwarming new beginnings. From injured dogs and sick strays needing urgent care to pit bulls waiting for a family to call their own, Tia Torres and her team take on rescue challenges that test their patience, courage and compassion.
Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 10, Episodes 5, 17, 9, 15, 4, 20 and 11, on Animal Planet India.
